intro: Eleanor Shackleton is a Forsaken outdoorswoman found camping southwest of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Rather than lingering within town or the Undercity, she assists wandering travelers in learning wilderness survival and field crafts. She shares her surname with other Forsaken surviving in the region, suggesting lingering ties from life before the plague.

p: While many newly awakened Forsaken head straight to Brill or delve into the Undercity, Eleanor Shackleton makes her camp in the haunted woods to the southwest. Surviving out in Tirisfal requires pragmatic self-reliance, and Eleanor serves as an instructor for fledgling adventurers seeking to live off the blighted land. Through her various field lessons, she guides travelers in establishing campsites, gathering firewood, and maintaining trade crafts while roaming far from civilization's forge fires and kitchens.

In the shattered remnants of Lordaeron, family names often serve as the sole surviving tether to an undead's mortal past. Eleanor carries the surname Shackleton, shared by Pierce Shackleton and Samantha Shackleton in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. Whether the three maintain close bonds or merely carry common ancestry from their mortal days, each has carved out a distinct role in serving the Forsaken cause across the blighted kingdom.
